title: 第2章
content_zh:
深吸了一口气，夏真钰尽量控制自己的脾气：如果你是这么想的，那么我得告诉你，我不会妥协，而且我还要告诉你我不同意你的想法，我的人生规划里必须有孩子，就是为我父母我也不会不要小孩。
李巍没想到一向容忍度很高的夏真钰会对自己说的事情态度这么强度，他事先也想她会反弹，自己鼓足了勇气终于在登记前说了出来。即使想过真钰不同意，但他也想好了说服她的理由，先不说他们的经济条件短期内不适合养小孩，而且工作方面也很不稳定，自己不想一辈子只呆在那个技术科里，总被人瞧不起，他还想努力争取能往上提一提。
夏真钰看着李巍又问道：你这个想法，你爸妈知道吗？
李巍莫明其妙的看了眼夏真钰说：这是我们二人的事情，我们不想要，我爸妈又能怎么样？
夏真钰冷笑：李巍，要我怎么说你好呢，是说你无知呢？还是说你自私？你觉得这个事儿就是我们二个人之间的事儿？你父母的想法根本不在你考虑范围之内？你怎么不想想你爸妈都盼着抱孙子呢，不然他们为什么用全部的积蓄给你买了房子，着急让我们结婚？
说完又仔细看了眼李巍，脑中突然有了一个奇怪的想法：李巍，你和我说实话，你性取向正不正常？夏真钰有这个想法还真不是乱想的，她记得李巍有一个好友，男的，却一心想当女人，又没钱做变性手术，只是存点钱就买点增加荷尔蒙的药吃，吃得现在不男不女的。
李巍不会和那人有什么不清不楚吧？李巍听了更是吃惊：怎么会啊，我和赵平上学时就认识，真钰你不要乱想好不好，也尊重下赵平的意愿，这样说话太伤人了。
夏真钰不想过多的纠缠赵平当男人还是当女人的话题上，最重要的是必须马上纠正李巍的观念，不然自己的人生计划启不是全被打乱了，这婚能不能结上还是个问题呢。
于是缓和了语气说：我当然尊重赵平，但是既然你说了你的想法，那么我也要说说我的，你现在才说这个事儿已经是很不尊重我了，你不想要孩子就应该早提出来，而不是等到现在给我一种被逼就范的感觉。还有李巍，你想没想过你有什么权利剥夺我想做母亲的权利？也请你尊重彼此的父母，你不是独立的个体，你有亲人就得顾忌他们的想法。
说到这里又停了一会儿，给李巍一些时间去消化她刚才说的话然后十分严肃的说：我就说这么多了，你回家自己想想吧，如果还坚持自己的意见的话，那么结婚登记的事情就取消吧，我会和我爸妈说明白的。
说完也不再理会李巍，出了办公室继续工作，但心里却并不平静，最坏的打算也就是取消婚礼，不过自己这个年龄再要重新找男朋谈婚论嫁估计要有些难度了。
李巍自己坐着发了一会儿呆，他本来觉得自己挺有道理的，让夏真钰这么一质问倒没底了，真钰说得也没错，自己这个时候提出这个问题却实有些胁迫的意思，可真钰也说了不会同意，而且还说会取消婚礼，这个是自己所不能接受的，先不说父母会如何，就是对单位同事他也闹不起这个笑话，而且真钰也有道理，自己不想要小孩子，也不能强迫真钰放弃做母亲的权利。
李巍有点垂头丧气，自己闹这么一出却什么结果也没换来，于是走了出来看夏真钰正收拾东西准备走呢，赶紧过去说道：真钰，我不用考虑了现在就可以给你答案。你刚才说得有道理是我想问题想左了，考虑得太不周全了，我同意要小孩，但能不能过个三五年再要呢，你也知道我们现在的状况。
夏真钰叹了口气说：过个三五年我是没问题的，不过你父母那你自己说吧。虽然还是要往后拖，不过总算是把他的死脑筋扳回来了，如果李巍的爸妈能同意，自己也没什么可说的。
我会和他们解释的，这点你不要担心了，这是我的想法，绝不会让他们埋怨你的。李巍保证着。
看着李巍有些受惊的样子，知道他还没从刚才自己的强硬态度中缓过来，于是主动拉起李巍的手笑着说：那这么说，一周以后的结婚登记还是照常进行喽？
当然照常，走吧我今天做错了事请你吃饭。被夏真钰主动亲近，李巍显然有些不习惯，交往这些日子，两人连手都没拉过几次，更别说其他情侣之间经常的拥抱和接吻了。
李巍总觉得夏真钰和一般的女孩子不一样，她不会主动要他做什么，也不爱逛街，也不像别的女孩会和男朋友撒撒娇什么的，连玩笑都很少开，但却非常聪明，对事情总有自己的见解，为人处事也比自己要懂得多。
所以自己无论生活还是工作上的事总是很想听听她的想法，而结果往往也是按照夏真钰的建议去做了，效果也不错。正因为这样自己对她多了尊重却少了柔情蜜意，想亲切些又胆怯得很。
夏真钰像看出了李巍的不自然，柔声说：李巍，你是不是不习惯我牵你的手啊？

哪有，我只是不习惯在大街上这样罢了，你要是喜欢，以后我会一直不放手的。李巍第一次说出了类似山盟海誓的言语。
夏真钰笑了，她满意的就是李巍这种温吞的性格，这样的男人结了婚不会和自己起争执，自己在家里会说了算，所以父母也不用担心自己过得不好，因为和李巍相处的这些日子，夏玉钰看得很清楚，李巍和他妈妈那边的亲戚来往很密切。
李巍家和他外公外婆、三个姨妈还有一个舅舅都住在一个小区里，而这么些亲戚就只有李巍这么一个男孩，从小就在姐妹堆里长大，长辈大多数又全是女性，所以李巍听话惯了性子也温和，当然这也是他不能真正做大事的根本原因，无论他年龄多大也总是习惯听家长的话，内心深处永远长不大。
这是缺点，而自己也恰好看中了这点，夏真钰很了解自己的性格，虽然外表看着柔弱，但内心却非常刚强，高梅丽有一点说得很对，自己头脑还是有些小聪明的，所以她要完全掌控自己的人生，既然自己不会爱任何人，那么就要找一个可以让自己过得舒服些、又听话的丈夫。
☆、挫败的新婚之夜
２７号是周一，夏真钰和李巍都请了假准备去婚姻登记处登记，李巍打车到了夏真钰家楼下接她，等一进登记处的大门才发现今天人真多，他们明明来得不晚却领了个５６号的等候牌，工作人员告诉他们至少得下午才能轮到，二人就去逛了街，快到中午时李巍请夏真钰去了一家高级西餐厅吃饭说是为了庆祝今天这个日子，夏真钰也挺高兴的。
等下午从婚姻登记处出来时都快五点了，二个都被折腾得没了精神，于是先送夏真钰回家，李巍也就离开了。
晚上天上班夏真钰给大家发了特意准备的糖，登记也得表示下的。
虽然登了记，但李巍也没提出让夏真钰先搬去一起住，夏真钰也乐得轻松，因为新房离自己单位实在是太远了些，坐公交车要１４站，下车还得走一站地，而相反离李巍的单位却步行不到十分钟，这也是李巍妈妈为什么还要坚持在原来小区买房子的原因，儿子上班近不遭罪啊。
接下来的日子就更加忙碌了，除了布置房子还要拍婚纱照、找化妆师又要订婚庆公司，这些事情李巍根本不管，当然他也做不好，而夏真钰又因为手里没多少钱，李家也拿不出太多钱，所以一到休息日就由高梅丽陪着四处砍价，等所有事情办好了人也累得瘦了一圈。
快到婚礼的日子时，夏真钰提前半个月给同事发了请帖，陈姐拿着请帖看了看问道：真钰啊，你这婚礼订得红杏酒店在哪啊？
其他同事也说不认得，问路怎么走，夏真钰说就在离单位不远的彩虹街上，挺好找的就在街头转角那，地方挺好找的。
听了夏真钰的话，同事们的眼神含义就丰富起来了，陈姐第一个忍不住了：我想起来了，那饭店能办婚礼吗？我天天上班路过那是不是小了点啊？
夏真钰笑着说：这不是饭店订得晚了吗，至少应该提前半年订的，结果现在大一些的饭店酒店都排满了，没法办。
陈姐想了想也没说什么，转身和别人聊天去了，夏真钰看同事们没问题了，就走回自己的办公桌前做事，偶尔听那边传来什么为省钱吧？、不能吧，那么大房子都全款买了。之类的话，也装作没听见不去理会，事实上就是没钱。
到了婚礼前一天，高梅丽在夏真钰家住下了，因为第二天４点就得起床还是不要来回折腾得好，快五点时已经化完了妆，婚纱也在家人的帮忙下换上了，看着父母忙忙碌碌的收拾屋子，夏真钰开始不舍了起来。
自己家里经济条件不是很好，父母只是普通工人，一辈子辛苦工作，最后只能靠那么点微薄的退休金度日，自己也没什么出息，那点工资连自己生活费都不够，更别说孝敬父母让他们过上更好的生活了。
想着自己就要离开爸妈，虽说还是在一个城市里，也经常能来看看，但就是不舍，不想离开这个家，不想在过年时只有他们二个老人冷清的过节，想着想着眼睛就模糊了。
唉，真钰这是怎么了？还没到哭嫁的时候呢，妆都糊了。高梅丽很知道夏真钰是伤心，父母在夏真钰心中是第一位的，有时宁可自己节省也要给她爸妈买些好东西。
哪有，别乱说，我这是困的打哈欠呢。
content_en:
Taking a deep breath, Xia Zhenyu tried to control his temper: If that's what you think, then I have to tell you that I will not compromise, and I also want to tell you that I don't agree with your idea. Children must be included in my life plan. Even for my parents, I will not give up on children.
Li Wei did not expect that Xia Zhenyu, who had always been very tolerant, would have such a strong attitude towards what he said. He had thought that she would rebound, so he mustered up the courage to finally speak out before registering. Even though he thought that Zhenyu disagreed, he also thought about the reasons to persuade her. Not to mention that their economic conditions were not suitable for raising children in the short term, and their work was also very unstable. He didn't want to just stay in that technical department all his life and always be looked down upon. He also wanted to work hard to be promoted.
Xia Zhenyu looked at Li Wei and asked: Do your parents know what you think?
Li Wei glanced at Xia Zhenyu inexplicably and said: This is a matter between the two of us. If we don't want it, what can my parents do?
Xia Zhenyu sneered: Li Wei, what do you want me to say about you? Do you mean you are ignorant? Or are you being selfish? Do you think this matter is between the two of us? Your parents' thoughts are not at all on your radar? Why don't you think about your parents looking forward to having grandchildren? Otherwise, why would they use all their savings to buy you a house and be anxious for us to get married?
After saying that, he looked at Li Wei carefully, and suddenly a strange thought came to his mind: Li Wei, tell me the truth, is your sexual orientation normal? Xia Zhenyu's idea was not random. She remembered that Li Wei had a good friend who was male, but he wanted to be a woman, and he didn't have money for sex reassignment surgery. She just saved some money and bought some hormone-increasing medicines to take, and now he is neither male nor female.
Li Wei wouldn't have any ambiguity with that person, would he? Li Wei was even more surprised when he heard this: How could it be possible? Zhao Ping and I have known each other since we were in school. Zhenyu, please don't think too much and respect Zhao Ping's wishes. It's too hurtful to speak like this.
Xia Zhenyu didn't want to get too entangled in the topic of whether Zhao Ping should be a man or a woman. The most important thing was to correct Li Wei's concept immediately, otherwise his life plan would be completely disrupted, and whether he could get married was still a question.
So he softened his tone and said: Of course I respect Zhao Ping, but since you have said your thoughts, I will also say mine. You are already disrespecting me by saying this now. If you don't want children, you should have mentioned it earlier, instead of waiting until now to make me feel like I was forced to submit. And Li Wei, have you ever thought about what rights you have to deprive me of my right to be a mother? Please also respect each other's parents. You are not an independent individual. If you have relatives, you have to worry about what they think.
She paused for a while, gave Li Wei some time to digest what she just said, and then said very seriously: That's all I have to say. You can think about it yourself when you go home. If you still insist on your opinion, then cancel the marriage registration. I will make it clear to my parents.
After saying that, he ignored Li Wei and left the office to continue working, but his heart was not at peace. The worst plan was to cancel the wedding, but at his age, it would probably be difficult to find a boyfriend again to talk about marriage.
Li Wei sat on his own in a daze for a while. He originally thought he was quite reasonable, but he was unsure when Xia Zhenyu asked him such a question. Zhenyu was right, but raising the question at this time was actually a bit of a coercion, but Zhenyu also said he would not agree. He also said that he would cancel the wedding, which he couldn't accept. Not to mention what would happen to his parents, he couldn't afford to make this joke even to his colleagues at work. Moreover, Zhenyu had a point. He didn't want children, and he couldn't force Zhenyu to give up his right to be a mother.
Li Wei was a little downcast. He had made such a fuss but got nothing in return, so he left.When he came out, he saw Xia Zhenyu packing his things and getting ready to leave. He hurried over and said, "Zhenyu, I can give you the answer now without thinking about it." What you just said makes sense, but I thought about the problem in the wrong direction and thought too poorly. I agree to have children, but can I wait three to five years before having children? You also know our current situation.
Xia Zhenyu sighed and said: I will be fine in three to five years, but your parents can decide for themselves. Although he still had to delay, he finally got his stubbornness back. If Li Wei's parents could agree, he would have nothing to say.
I will explain to them, don't worry about this, this is my idea, and I will never let them blame you. Li Wei promised.
Seeing Li Wei's frightened look, knowing that he had not yet recovered from his tough attitude just now, he took Li Wei's hand and said with a smile: So, the marriage registration in one week will continue as usual?
Of course, as usual, let's go. I did something wrong today and invited you to dinner. Li Wei was obviously not used to being approached by Xia Zhenyu. During these days of dating, the two of them had not even held hands a few times, let alone the frequent hugs and kisses between other couples.
Li Wei always felt that Xia Zhenyu was different from ordinary girls. She would not take the initiative to ask him to do anything, nor did she like to go shopping, nor was she like other girls who would act coquettishly with her boyfriend. She rarely even joked, but she was very smart, always had her own opinions on things, and knew how to deal with others better than herself.
Therefore, I always wanted to hear her thoughts whether it was about life or work, and in the end, I often followed Xia Zhenyu's suggestions, and the results were good. Because of this, I have more respect for her but less tenderness and sweetness. I want to be more affectionate but am very timid.
Xia Zhenyu seemed to notice Li Wei's unnaturalness and said softly: Li Wei, are you not used to me holding your hand?
No, I'm just not used to doing this on the street. If you like it, I will never let you go. For the first time, Li Wei uttered words similar to an eternal oath.
Xia Zhenyu smiled. She was satisfied with Li Wei's gentle character. Such a man would not argue with her when he got married, and he would have the final say at home, so his parents did not have to worry about his bad life, because during the days he spent with Li Wei, Xia Yuyu saw clearly that Li Wei had close contacts with his mother's relatives.
Li Wei's family lives in a community with his grandparents, three aunts, and an uncle. Among these relatives, there is only one boy like Li Wei. He has grown up among sisters. Most of his elders are women, so Li Wei is accustomed to being obedient and gentle. Of course, this is also the fundamental reason why he cannot really do great things. No matter how old he is, he is always used to listening to his parents. Deep down, he will never grow up.
This is a shortcoming, and she happens to take advantage of this. Xia Zhenyu understands her character very well. Although she looks weak on the outside, she is very strong on the inside. Gao Meili is right about one thing. She is still a little clever, so she must fully control her life. Since she will not love anyone, she must find a husband who can make her life more comfortable and obedient.
☆. Frustrated wedding night
The 27th was Monday. Both Xia Zhenyu and Li Wei took leave to register at the marriage registration office. Li Wei took a taxi to pick her up at the downstairs of Xia Zhenyu's house. When he entered the gate of the registration office, he realized that there were so many people today. They obviously arrived not late but got a 56 There was a waiting sign for the number, and the staff told them that their turn would have to be at least in the afternoon, so the two went shopping. When it was almost noon, Li Wei invited Xia Zhenyu to a high-end Western restaurant for dinner, saying that it was to celebrate today, and Xia Zhenyu was also very happy.
It was almost five o'clock when they came out of the marriage registration office in the afternoon. Both of them were exhausted from the torment, so they sent Xia Zhenyu home first, and Li Wei alsoJust left.
When Xia Zhenyu went to work in the evening, she gave out specially prepared candies to everyone, and she had to show her willingness to register.
Although he registered, Li Wei did not ask Xia Zhenyu to move in together first. Xia Zhenyu was also happy and relaxed, because the new house was too far away from her work. It took 14 stops by bus and one stop to get off. On the contrary, it was less than ten minutes' walk from Li Wei's work. This is why Li Wei's mother insisted on buying a house in the original community. Her son would not have to suffer from work.
The following days were even busier. In addition to decorating the house, taking wedding photos, finding a make-up artist, and an engagement company, Li Wei didn't care about these things at all, and of course he couldn't do them well. Xia Zhenyu didn't have much money at hand, and the Li family couldn't come up with much money, so Gao Meili accompanied her to bargain around on the days off. After all the things were done, she was so tired that she lost weight.
When the wedding day was approaching, Xia Zhenyu sent invitations to her colleagues half a month in advance. Sister Chen took the invitations, looked at them and asked: Zhenyu, where is the Hongxing Hotel you booked for your wedding?
Other colleagues also said they didn't recognize it and asked for directions. Xia Zhenyu said it was on Rainbow Street, not far from the work, and it was very easy to find. It was on the corner of the street and the place was very easy to find.
After hearing Xia Zhenyu's words, the expressions in the colleagues' eyes became richer in meaning. Sister Chen was the first to couldn't help it: Now that I think about it, can the hotel hold weddings? I pass by it every day at work. Is it a little too small?
Xia Zhenyu smiled and said: Isn't it because the hotel was booked late? It should have been booked at least half a year in advance. But now the bigger hotels are fully booked and there is nothing we can do.
Sister Chen thought for a while without saying anything, and turned around to chat with others. Xia Zhenyu saw that her colleagues were fine, so she walked back to her desk to work. Occasionally, she heard something coming from over there. Why not save money? , No, I bought such a big house in full. I pretended not to hear and ignore such things, but in fact I just had no money.
The day before the wedding, Gao Meili stayed at Xia Zhenyu's house. Since she had to get up at 4 o'clock the next day, it was better not to go back and forth. By almost five o'clock, she had finished putting on her makeup and put on the wedding dress with the help of her family. Seeing her parents busy cleaning up the house, Xia Zhenyu began to feel reluctant to leave.
My family's financial situation is not very good. My parents are just ordinary workers. They have worked hard all their lives. In the end, they can only live on a meager pension. I have no future. The salary is not even enough for my own living expenses, let alone honoring my parents so that they can live a better life.
I thought about leaving my parents. Although they were still in the same city and could often come to visit, I just couldn't bear to leave. I didn't want to leave this home. I didn't want to spend the Chinese New Year alone with just the two of them. My eyes became blurry just thinking about it.
Alas, what happened to Zhenyu? It's not time to cry for marriage yet, the makeup is all blurred. Gao Meili knew very well that Xia Zhenyu was sad. Her parents were the first priority in Xia Zhenyu's heart. Sometimes she would rather save herself than buy some good things for her parents.
No, don't talk nonsense, I'm sleepy and yawning.
